[i]what the K*hretsin![/i] shouts a soldier as the ground begins to shake. They have never experienced the true supernatural before. They watch in amazement as Balunji performs his magic, but soon snap back to concentration and continue to hold their ground against the attackers. The sound of gun fire fills the air around the camp, an eerie scene to behold. Some time has passed since backup was requested and yet, nothing appears. The signal has been jammed.

30 minutes pass and now the death count is up to 3.
[i]"Wurtalpa, We're gonna have to leave! We can't hold them off forever and our signal has been jammed, so reinforcements aren't on the way. Our government has to know about this,"[/i] Hayri says as another soldiers drops down dead. The helicopter is now under heavy fire, so in an attempt to gain cover for a few minutes to board the vehicle, the seargent gives the order to fire their only two missiles over towards the mysterious attackers. An explosion is heard, rocks and sand are thrown into the air. The soldiers begin rushing into the helicopter, making use of the lack of bullets incoming. It takes a lot to haul the wounded across, but it is managed and all of the alive soldiers are inside the helicopter. Hayri turns round to the council members,
[i]"You coming? We've got room, but they're gonna start shooting again soon, I suggest you make your decision quickly"[/i]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم 
In the Name of Allah, the Most Merciful, Most Compassionate[/i]

As salaamu alaikum to all nations. Baladullah is a nation of peace and diplomacy, but we only achieved such a status by the will of Allah swt and after many struggles. From 1961-1977 there was an insurgency waged by separatist forces in the region of Djallama, where some Djellalan Christian groups that were allied with Djellalan nationalist forces waged a bloody war for independence because of years of marginalization and economic underdevelopment. 

The conflict was resolved in 1977 when the Araby supremacist military regime of General Abdullah al-Qurazi agreed to step down and a new constitution and government were formed. This brought the Islamic constitutional monarchy back into power after it had been removed by a coup in 1956. The region of Djallama gained autonomy, strict anti discrimination laws were put into place, and economic investment increased in the region. 

In the end, it was good faith negotiations and a desire for peace and compromise that resolved the situation. In shaa Allah, we can play such a role in helping to resolve other wars and increase trade, cooperation, and integration amongst nations. We are aware that the IA is the forum for such discussions, and we wish to join, in shaa Allah.[/quote]

[b]A letter from the Arenett Stated Socialist Republics:[/b]

We have received your message that asks to join the International Alliance. Your reason to join The I.A is to help dissolve conflicts, promote trade, and solve the problem of communication and corruption. The I.A's purpose is to do exactly this, and we'd be happy to accept you. This means that your request has been [b]accepted[/b], and you are a fully fledged member of the International Alliance. You will be added onto the list of I.A members shortly.

[b]Extra info for the members.[/b]

Feel free to give any feedback about the I.A in the telegrams. remember that [nation]New Westmore[/nation], [nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation]/[nation]Oceanice Republic[/nation], [nation]United Hydronia[/nation], and [nation]Sikirsk[/nation] are all founders of the I.A, so you can send your feedback to them as well. In cordone's discord, we have a channel dedicated to the I.A, so if you have Discord, you should check it out.

You may also submit a vote into the International Alliance, so that people may discuss that issue, and pass the vote. These votes act as rules, meaning if the vote passes, all member nations will have to follow those rules. You may write this proposal with no restrictions, but it is up to the member nations to vote for it. Member nations may vote against the proposal if it is too strict. In the International Alliance, there are a council of six nations. This council of nations are the strongest in Erene, and are considered a superpower. These nations may completely veto a vote if they want. All member nations may enact the proposal for their own nation anyway even if it gets declined.

Eles param um momento para olharem para si mesmos, Balunji diz.
[i]Eu não posso partir ainda, e vocês são os alvos, não nós...[/i]
Tjarrampa puxa Balunji pelo ombro e diz.
[i] Nosso povo não é o alvo, e mesmos e fosse, há dezenas de clãs aqui que podem e vão proteger nossa terra,  Ngarrajin e eu somos um deles, vocês  podem partir.
[/i]
[i]Tão dramático...[/i]
Ngarrajin diz em tom baixo, no final, e puxa Tjarrampa e Dulbara .
[i] Nós dois vamos então.[/i]
Wurtalpa e Balunji dizem, embora o último seja mais relutante, Wurtalpa salta para o veículo metálico e puxa Balunji junto para dentro.
[i] Oque diabos é essa coisa metálica voadora.....[/i]
Balunji diz ao entrar.
They stop for a moment to look at themselves, Balunji says.
[i]I can't leave yet, and you are the targets, not us...[/i]
Tjarrampa pulls Balunji by the shoulder and says.
[i]Our people are not the targets, and even if they were, there are dozens of clans here who can and will protect our land, Ngarrajin and I are one of them, you can leave.
[/i]
[i]So dramatic...[/i]
Ngarrajin says in a low tone, at the end, and pulls Tjarrampa and Dulbara.
[i]We'll both go then.[/i]
Wurtalpa and Balunji say, although the latter is more reluctant, Wurtalpa jumps onto the metal vehicle and pulls Balunji along inside.
[i]What the hell is this flying metal thing.....[/i]
Balunji says as he enters.
